text: Rehearse a song in secret as a group, then ambush one player with a full serenade. Harmonies optional, choreography mandatory.
Recreate a famous album cover as a group photo shoot. Costumes, props, the exact pose. Frame the winner.
Learn a dance from a music video, every step, and perform it for each other. Costumes strongly encouraged.
Spend a whole day letting a coin flip choose every turn, every meal, every stop. Go wherever it sends you.
Take a class neither of you would ever pick: fencing, trapeze, glassblowing. Whoever's worse buys dinner.
Swap chores for a week. All of them, including the gross one nobody ever talks about.
Write each other letters, seal them, and hide them somewhere safe. Open them together in five years.
Host a progressive dinner: one course at each player's place. Every host picks the theme and the dress code.
Throw a roast-and-toast night: draw a name, prepare two minutes of roast and two minutes of toast, then deliver both.
Secret vote: if everyone says yes, do a sunrise cold-water plunge together, then a huge breakfast to recover.
Everyone writes one thing they've never told this group, anonymously. Shuffle, read them aloud over dessert, then guess.
Swap who drives, who navigates, and who controls the music for a week. Zero backseat commentary allowed.
Recreate your first date beat for beat: same place, same order, same outfit if it fits. Same awkward goodbye optional.
Plan a mystery date they know nothing about. All they get is a dress code and a pickup time.
Leave them a love note every day for a week, each hidden somewhere stranger than the last.
Swap date-planning for a month. Whoever usually plans sits back; whoever usually follows plans everything.
Swap morning routines for a week: their alarm, their breakfast, their coffee order, their playlist.
Swap who says 'I love you' first for a week. The usual first-sayer is only allowed to say it back.
Spend an entire day in bed together. Phones off and in another room. Meals in bed. Leave only when you have to.
Secret vote: if everyone says yes, go skinny-dipping somewhere secluded under the stars. Nobody around, nothing on.
Cook a three-course dinner wearing nothing but aprons. Anything that burns, you start over. Maybe.
Take a couples massage class, then give each other the full routine at home, candles and all.
Go dancing somewhere loud and dance only with each other. Leave the second someone whispers 'let's go home.'
Recreate a famous movie kiss: the rain, the upside-down, the dramatic dip. Commit fully. No laughing until after.
Make out in a photo booth until the last frame, then hang the strip somewhere you'll see it every day.
Handwrite them a real love letter, three pages minimum, and read it aloud to them in the bath.
Rent a cabin with no signal for a weekend. Pack food, a deck of cards, and nothing to wear to bed.
Shower together by the light of a single candle and wash each other slowly, head to toe.
Sit in the back row of a late movie and make out like it's your first date. Leave before the credits.
Spend a whole evening touching only hands, faces, and hair. Nothing else, no matter how tempting it gets.
Kiss at the top of something tall: a rooftop, a mountain, a ferris wheel. Hold it until your knees go weak.
Wake them at 3 a.m. for a planned surprise: blankets outside, something warm to drink, the stars, and you.
Swap wardrobes for a day: each picks the other's full outfit, underwear included, and they wear it out.
Swap who initiates for a week. Whoever usually reaches first has to wait. Whoever usually waits makes every move.
Take a pole or striptease class together, then perform your routine for each other within the month.
Play naked Twister. Loser of each round picks where the winner gets kissed next.
Book a hotel in your own city. Arrive separately, meet at the bar as strangers, and let them pick you up.
Secret vote: if everyone says yes, hold a 24-hour yes day. Agree on limits first, then every ask gets a yes.
Take boudoir photos of each other: good light, your best everything, and a private album only you two see.
Cook a candlelit dinner at home, dress up properly, and remove one piece of clothing per course.
Declare a no-clothes weekend at home. Robes for the door, then right back to nothing.
Text them every hour for a whole day, each message hotter than the last, until they walk through the door.
Reenact the sexiest scene from a film you both love, dialogue included, until you can't keep a straight face.
Blindfold one of you from dinner through dessert to bed. The other narrates, feeds, and guides. Switch next weekend.
Visit a sensual shop together. Each secretly buys one gift for the other. Unwrap them that night.
Write out a detailed fantasy, seal it, and hand it over. They have one month to make it real.
Go to a fancy dinner with nothing on under your clothes. Only you two know. Act completely normal.
Swap who's in charge in the bedroom for one night. Agree on limits, then the usual leader follows every instruction.
Swap who seduces whom: the one usually pursued sets the scene, the music, the outfit, and the opening line.
Have sex somewhere semi-public you can actually get away with. Discreet, private, nobody sees. Plan the escape route.
Tease each other for a full week: kisses, touches, whispered promises. No sex until Sunday night.
Secret vote: if everyone says yes, try the thing that's been on your wish list the longest. Limits first, then go.
Have sex in every room of your home in one weekend. Yes, the laundry room counts.
Write each other a filthy short story starring the two of you. Swap and read them aloud in bed.
Spend a whole night with no hands allowed, only mouths. Whoever uses hands first makes breakfast.
Go out to dinner while one of you wears a remote-controlled toy and the other holds the remote.
Write a menu of ten things you want them to do to you. They order one each night for ten nights.
Try a new position every night for a week. Keep a secret scorecard. Crown a winner on day seven.
Prop a mirror beside the bed, leave the lights on, and keep your eyes open the whole time.
Spend one night doing to them exactly what they usually do to you, move for move. They'll get the message.
